name: state-machine
description: Deterministically validate, step, simulate, inspect, diff, and find paths through finite-state Machine Specs.

interface.longDescription: State Machine gives Codex read-only tools for validating finite-state Machine Specs, applying one event, simulating sequences, finding shortest structural paths, inspecting topology, and comparing semantic changes. Guards remain explicit inputs and effects are returned as intents only; the plugin never executes external actions.
defaultPrompt: Simulate these events through this state machine.
Can this event happen from the current state?
Find the shortest path to this target state.
